meta.title: LAN Proxy
meta.description: Access the dsh web UI over the LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WebSocket forwarding to the loopback server with TLS and DNS-rebinding protection.

en.bodyHint: Saving hot-reloads the forwarder (config goes to the host settings store, no restart needed). After the port changes, LAN devices use the new port and the old one stops immediately.
en.caCertPlaceholder: Empty = no CA served (self-signed/orphan leaf never served)
en.caConfigError: Certificate state: misconfigured (incomplete key triple or missing managed files)
en.caConfirmBody: This overwrites the existing certificate materials (the most recent backup is kept). Only the leaf is rotated by default: the CA is reused and installed devices keep working; rotating the CA invalidates trust on all installed devices and each must reinstall it.
en.caDisabledNoCa: No usable CA configured: the download link yields 404. Generate a local CA first, or configure a CA public key.
en.caDownloadHint: iPhone: tap the link in Safari to install the profile, then enable trust in Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings; Android: Settings → Security → Install CA certificate (self-packaged WebViews must opt in to user CAs); Windows: double-click the .cer into Trusted Root Certification Authorities (Local Machine). Zero warnings after reopening; a 404 without a CA is expected — generate a local CA first or configure the CA per the hint.
en.caExpiring: The leaf certificate is expiring ({date}): rotating the leaf is recommended (CA unchanged)
en.caFilesMissing: Managed files are missing or the key triple is incomplete: clear the three certificate keys back to self-signed to regenerate, or restore the missing files.
en.caIpChanged: LAN IPs changed (current {ips}): the leaf SANs do not cover them; rotating the leaf is recommended (CA unchanged)
en.caModeCustom: Certificate state: custom certificate (one-click generation disabled)
en.caModeSelfSigned: Certificate state: self-signed (no CA, download unavailable)
en.caRevisionStale: Settings revision unknown. Refresh and retry.
en.compressOn: HTTP response compression: on · negotiated {neg} · passthrough {pass}
en.hostTrustStatusCompat: Topology fact: compat mode is in effect (this page declared ownsHost)
en.hostTrustStatusDrift: Topology fact WARNING: the injection marker is present but upstream isLoopback is still not true — the upstream contract may have drifted and this injection is likely dead; re-check per the dsh-upgrade flow
en.hostTrustStatusLoopback: Topology fact: local page — settings persistence available (no compat switch needed)
en.hostTrustStatusOff: Topology fact: this page has no settings surface (upstream downgraded the non-loopback page to memory scope). Turn on the compat switch above and reload this page to restore persistent settings.
en.httpsPortRangeFail: Save failed: HTTPS port must be an integer 1-65535
en.injectTokenOnHint: On: any device that can reach this port on the LAN gets full control of dsh (including terminal command execution) without a login token — equivalent to trusting the entire LAN. Only enable on trusted home/office networks; after turning off, already-signed-in devices stay valid until session expiry (~30 days), no instant revocation.
en.levelRangeFail: Save failed: compression level must be an integer 0-3
en.ownsHostCompatHint: On: non-loopback pages are told to declare ownsHost — equivalent to forging an upstream topology fact. Remote pages and local pages become indistinguishable in the UI. Unlocked behaviours: settings persistence to <DSH_HOME>/settings.yaml (created when missing) and the host-native "open settings file" action. This is not a server-side authorization change (/api fences and launch-token / session-cookie auth are unchanged). Enable only if you accept the consequences; see the ssh -L zero-forgery alternative in the README Security Model.
en.portRangeFail: Save failed: LAN port (HTTP) must be an integer 1-65535
en.saveFailConflict: Save failed: {msg} (close and reopen this card, then retry)
en.settingsDescription: LAN port / HTTPS / certificate / compression / banner
en.wsPathsHint: Controls compression scope only; empty = bridged without compression, keep-alive unaffected (no more frequent mobile reconnects)
